description: List repo issues (page/limit). Returns a response envelope {issues, page, limit, count, has_next}. has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it.

outFile.description: Bare file name. Writes the whole listing (every page) as a JSON array into the forgejo-mcp temp dir and replies {path,count,keys}; an existing file is overwritten. A listing over 1,000 issues (the file-output ceiling) fails and writes nothing. Refused with page or limit, and on the sse and http transports.

sort.description: Server-side sort order. One of: relevance, latest, oldest, recentupdate, leastupdate, mostcomment, leastcomment, nearduedate, farduedate. Default is the API's own default (latest).

verbose.description: Return the full entity instead of the compact summary. Default false.

name: list_repo_issues
